center.type: Census ZCTA internal representative point, used as reproducible ZIP center proxy

scope: National, regional, and candidate local multi-location restaurants, fast food, cafes and dessert shops. Grocery-only brands and independent single-location restaurants excluded. Chain food-service kiosks at Carolina Place and Carowinds included.
limitations: ZIP code has area, not a unique center; this uses a Census representative point and not a home address or ZIP boundary buffer.
OSM inventory snapshot is older than audit date and may omit new restaurants or retain closed ones.
Map candidates are discovery evidence, not proof of current operation. Primary directory confirmation is tracked separately.
Shopping-center coordinates are explicitly approximate; they establish broad radius inclusion but not precise restaurant distance.
Nutrition import completeness must be checked separately from chain location eligibility.
